newsitem.title: UK: NWE naphtha weaker with crude, n+a still sought.
newsitem.headline: NWE naphtha weaker with crude, n+a still sought.

text.p: NWE naphtha was weaker on Thursday although strength in Asia continued to provide a little support to prices.
"Naphtha still looks relatively good relative to crude," one dealer said.
Tanker brokers reported fresh fixtures of the 30,000 tonne Seabravery and the 30,000 tonne Gorgona from Skikda for mid June although dealers said these were not actively on offer.
N+a naphtha remains in relatively good demand and was talked at a premium of a couple of dollars over full-range material.
